title: Homotopy and exact-derived graph projections are degreewise sheaf projections
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f:U\to X$ etale, $c=(i:U\to Z,p:Z\to X)$ a compactification, and $a:f_!\to i_!p_*$ a sheaf comparison as in [lem-a2-compact-support-derived-projection]. Define the ordinary-sheaf projection $\delta_a=(p^*a);\varepsilon_p:f_!p^*\to i_!$. The homotopy projection of that node equals the degreewise image of $\delta_a$ preceded by the canonical homotopy composition comparison. Its descended exact-derived projection is $(D(f_!p^*)\simeq Df_!Dp^*)^{-1};D\delta_a$, where $D$ on natural transformations is [lem-a2-exact-derived-natural-transformations]. These are identities of the specified transformations on the whole unbounded categories.

source.place: SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11; Tags 0F4L (lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale) and 04VG (lemma-properties-left-localization); degreewise adjunction transpose

proof.text: Represent an arbitrary homotopy object by a complex. The mapped adjunction counit and the homotopy composition isomorphism have the corresponding degreewise counit and identity components. At every degree the two morphisms are p*.map(a_M);ε_p, exactly the definition of δ_a. Extensionality of complex maps proves the homotopy formula.

Compare the descended maps after Qh and compose with the source composition factor and target exact factor. The defining descent equation and the homotopy formula identify both sides; the normalization formula for the exact composition isomorphism cancels the remaining factors. Localization extensionality proves equality.

theorem compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection_termwise
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (a : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⟶
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g) :
    compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection A f c a =
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance)
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)).inv ≫
      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans (compactSupportGraphSheafProjection A f c a)
